title: Sorting and Filtering Data in DB Browser for SQLite
description: A short, hands-on course that teaches beginners how to explore, sort, and filter data using DB Browser for SQLite, built entirely around a single e-commerce orders dataset.
target_audience: Beginner data analysts with no SQL experience

videos.title: Browsing Your Data
videos.learning_objective: Understand how data is organized into rows and columns and view it inside DB Browser for SQLite.

exercise_artifact.description: A single Orders table representing customer purchases from an online store.

videos.new_capability: Opening a table and viewing its rows and columns in the Browse Data tab
videos.running_example_usage: The learner opens the Orders table containing customer purchase records.
videos.proof_numbers: The Orders table has 250 rows and 6 columns; the first row shows OrderID 1001.

videos.title: Sorting by One Column
videos.learning_objective: Learn to sort a table's rows by a single column in ascending or descending order.

exercise_artifact.description: A single Orders table representing customer purchases from an online store.

videos.new_capability: Clicking a column header to sort rows ascending or descending
videos.running_example_usage: The learner sorts the Orders table by TotalAmount to find the cheapest and priciest orders.
videos.proof_numbers: Sorted ascending, the lowest TotalAmount is $5.99; sorted descending, the highest is $499.99.

videos.title: Filtering by an Exact Match
videos.learning_objective: Learn to filter rows that exactly match a text value using the column filter box.

exercise_artifact.description: A single Orders table representing customer purchases from an online store.

videos.new_capability: Typing a value into a column's filter box to show only matching rows
videos.running_example_usage: The learner filters the Orders table to show only rows where Status equals 'Shipped'.
videos.proof_numbers: Filtering Status = 'Shipped' returns 132 of the 250 total orders.

videos.title: Filtering by a Numeric Condition
videos.learning_objective: Learn to filter rows using numeric comparison operators like greater-than in the filter box.

exercise_artifact.description: A single Orders table representing customer purchases from an online store.

videos.new_capability: Using comparison operators (e.g., >100) in a numeric column's filter box
videos.running_example_usage: The learner filters the Orders table to find high-value purchases above $200.
videos.proof_numbers: Filtering TotalAmount > 200 returns 47 of the 250 total orders.

running_example.name: E-commerce Orders Dataset
running_example.description: A single Orders table representing customer purchases from an online store.
